descriptions: Public opinion on refusal of military service. Opinions on refusal of military service / refusal to serve in UN-army in the Lebanon / refusal to guard nuclear weapons by both regular soldiers and conscripted soldiers / consequences of refusal. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
